```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(raster)
library(broom)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpattern)
library(ggsci)
library(rnaturalearth)
# library(terra)

```

Plots the summed ET and ET/P maps. Also plots the ET by latitude.

```{r load summed ET data}

warm <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/summed gridcells/warm_cell_et_sums.csv") %>% select(-c(X))
dry <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/summed gridcells/dry_cell_et_sums.csv") %>% select(-c(X))
wd <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/summed gridcells/warmdry_cell_et_sums.csv") %>% select(-c(X))

```

Need to mask out ice areas
```{r loading snow classes}

snow <- raster("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/Snow Classifications/snowClass_resample_terraclim_resolution_northern_hem.tif")
snow.df <- as.data.frame(snow,xy=TRUE)
snow_crop <- crop(snow,warm.rast) #run this after load the rasters in in the next chunk


```

```{r plotting map}
warm.rast <- rasterFromXYZ(warm)
crs(warm.rast) <- "epsg:4326"
warm_masked <- mask(warm.rast,snow_crop,maskvalue=7)
p_warm = projectRaster(warm_masked, crs = "+proj=robin",method = "bilinear")
p_warm.df <- as.data.frame(p_warm,xy=TRUE)

wd.rast <- rasterFromXYZ(wd)
crs(wd.rast) <- "epsg:4326"
wd_masked <- mask(wd.rast,snow_crop,maskvalue=7)
p_wd = projectRaster(wd_masked, crs = "+proj=robin",method = "bilinear")
p_wd.df <- as.data.frame(p_wd,xy=TRUE)

dry.rast <- rasterFromXYZ(dry)
crs(dry.rast) <- "epsg:4326"
dry_masked <- mask(dry.rast,snow_crop,maskvalue=7)
p_dry = projectRaster(dry_masked, crs = "+proj=robin",method = "bilinear")
p_dry.df <- as.data.frame(p_dry,xy=TRUE)


worldmap <- ne_countries(scale = 'medium', type = 'map_units',
                         returnclass = 'sf')

base_test <- ggplot(worldmap) + 
  geom_sf(fill="lightgrey", color="black",linewidth=.25)+
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin",ylim = c(2226390,8358252)) + 
  theme_linedraw() + theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
                           panel.grid = element_line(linewidth=1))

warm_plot <- base_test + geom_raster(data = p_warm.df, aes(fill = et_final, x = x, y = y)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "",title="Warm") + #change here for title
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#593722FF","#834D24FF", "#AB5D26FF", "#C3722AFF","#E1C473FF",
  "white","#A4B591FF","#55804DFF","#416C39FF","#2C5724FF","#005C55FF"),
                       values = rescale(c(-518,0,167)),
                       guide = "colorbar", limits=c(-518,167),
                       na.value="NA")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "pt"),   # ← THIS IS KEY
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
        plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5)
        )

png("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/summed gridcells/warm-scale-robinson.png",width=6,height=3,units="in",res=1200)
print(warm_plot)
dev.off()


dry_plot <- base_test + geom_raster(data = p_dry.df, aes(fill = et_final, x = x, y = y)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "",title="Dry") + #change here for title
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#593722FF","#834D24FF", "#AB5D26FF", "#C3722AFF","#E1C473FF",
  "white","#A4B591FF","#55804DFF","#416C39FF","#2C5724FF","#005C55FF"),
                       values = rescale(c(-518,0,167)),
                       guide = "colorbar", limits=c(-518,167),
                       na.value="NA")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "pt"),   # ← THIS IS KEY
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
        plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5)
        )

png("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/summed gridcells/dry-scale-robinson.png",width=6,height=3,units="in",res=1200)
print(dry_plot)
dev.off()



warmdry_plot <- base_test + geom_raster(data = p_wd.df, aes(fill = et_final, x = x, y = y)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "",title="Warm-Dry") + #change here for title
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#593722FF","#834D24FF", "#AB5D26FF", "#C3722AFF","#E1C473FF",
  "white","#A4B591FF","#55804DFF","#416C39FF","#2C5724FF","#005C55FF"),
                       values = rescale(c(-518,0,167)),
                       guide = "colorbar", limits=c(-518,167),
                       na.value="NA")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "pt"),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5)
        )

png("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/summed gridcells/warmdry-scale-robinson.png",width=6,height=3,units="in",res=1200)
print(warmdry_plot)
dev.off()

```

Using the data read in the previous chunk, create histogram of fluxes by latitude

```{r plotting fluxes by latitude}

warm_lat <- as.data.frame(warm_masked,xy=TRUE)
warm_lat$dir <- ifelse(warm_lat$et_final >= 0 , "Pos","Neg")
warm_lat$y_round <- round(warm_lat$y)
warm_sum_plot <- warm_lat %>% select(y_round,dir,et_final) %>% group_by(dir,y_round) %>% summarize_all(sum,na.rm=TRUE)


warm_bar_lat <- ggplot(warm_sum_plot, aes(x = y_round,y=et_final,fill=dir)) + 
  geom_col(position="identity")+
  coord_flip()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#593722FF","#005C55FF"))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(30, 80, by = 10), # Specify exact break points
    labels = c("30", "40", "50", "60", "70", "80"), # Custom labels for breaks
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_scientific(),
                     limits = c(-8300000,2000000),
                     n.breaks = 3)+
  labs(x = "Latitude",y="")+
  theme(legend.position = "NULL",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color="grey",linetype = 2),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))

wd_lat <- as.data.frame(wd_masked,xy=TRUE)
wd_lat$dir <- ifelse(wd_lat$et_final >= 0 , "Pos","Neg")
wd_lat$y_round <- round(wd_lat$y)
wd_sum_plot <- wd_lat %>% select(y_round,dir,et_final) %>% group_by(dir,y_round) %>% summarize_all(sum,na.rm=TRUE)

wd_bar_lat <- ggplot(wd_sum_plot, aes(x = y_round,y=et_final,fill=dir)) + 
  geom_col(position="identity")+
  coord_flip()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#593722FF","#005C55FF"))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(30, 80, by = 10), # Specify exact break points
    labels = c("30", "40", "50", "60", "70", "80"), # Custom labels for breaks
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_scientific(),
                     limits = c(-8300000,2000000),
                     n.breaks = 3)+
  labs(y="ET (mm)",x="")+
  theme(legend.position = "NULL",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color="grey",linetype = 2),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))

dry_lat <- as.data.frame(dry_masked,xy=TRUE)
dry_lat$dir <- ifelse(dry_lat$et_final >= 0 , "Pos","Neg")
dry_lat$y_round <- round(dry_lat$y)
dry_sum_plot <- dry_lat %>% select(y_round,dir,et_final) %>% group_by(dir,y_round) %>% summarize_all(sum,na.rm=TRUE)

dry_bar_lat <- ggplot(dry_sum_plot, aes(x = y_round,y=et_final,fill=dir)) + 
  geom_col(position="identity")+
  coord_flip()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#593722FF","#005C55FF"))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(30, 80, by = 10), # Specify exact break points
    labels = c("30", "40", "50", "60", "70", "80"), # Custom labels for breaks
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_scientific(),
                     limits = c(-8300000,2000000),
                     n.breaks = 3)+
  labs(x = "",y="")+
  theme(legend.position = "NULL",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color="grey",linetype = 2),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))

bars <- ggarrange(dry_bar_lat,warm_bar_lat,wd_bar_lat,ncol=1,nrow=3)

png("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/plotting/summed gridcells/bars_lat.png",width=2,height=6,units="in",res=1200)
print(bars)
dev.off()


```

#############################################
Using the same code as above to plot the partitioning fractions.

```{r load partition data data}

warm <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/warm_cell_partitions.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-c(X))
dry <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/dry_cell_partitions.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-c(X))
wd <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/warmdry_cell_partitions.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-c(X))
nodrought <- read.csv("D:/NASA/SBG Drought/nodrought_cell_partitions.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-c(X))

```

```{r averaging data}
dry$first <- rowMeans(dry[3:34],na.rm=TRUE)
dry$first[which(dry$first > 1)] <- NA
dry$second <- rowMeans(dry[35:66],na.rm=TRUE)
dry$second[which(dry$second > 1)] <- NA
dry$dif <- dry$second - dry$first
dry <- dry %>% dplyr::select(x,y,dif)

warm$first <- rowMeans(warm[3:34],na.rm=TRUE)
warm$first[which(warm$first > 1)] <- NA
warm$second <- rowMeans(warm[35:66],na.rm=TRUE)
warm$second[which(warm$second > 1)] <- NA
warm$dif <- warm$second - warm$first
warm <- warm %>% dplyr::select(x,y,dif)

wd$first <- rowMeans(wd[3:34],na.rm=TRUE)
wd$first[which(wd$first > 1)] <- NA
wd$second <- rowMeans(wd[35:66],na.rm=TRUE)
wd$second[which(wd$second > 1)] <- NA
wd$dif <- wd$second - wd$first
wd <- wd %>% dplyr::select(x,y,dif)

```
